column2: Yeah... I hope I can get there... Someday, anyway...{wait}{clear}Thanks... ＄＄＄＄＄＄, really... If you hadn't been here... I don't think I could have done anything.{wait}{clear}I'm grateful...{wait}{clear}
Hey... ＄＄＄＄＄＄. Do I look like my sister?{wait}{clear}
Yes, I can... see her in you.{wait}{clear}
I thought so too when I looked in the mirror...{wait}{clear}
That I really do look like Sis.{wait}{clear}
When I looked in the mirror, I thought...{wait}{clear}
that I really do look like Sis...{wait}{clear}
I've been so selfish this whole time, haven't I...{wait}{clear}
You know, I think this spell broke thanks to you...{wait}{clear}
I don't know why, but that's what I think...{wait}{clear}
If this world ever becomes peaceful...{wait}{clear}
will you go back to the Heavens?{wait}{clear}
Yes...{wait}{clear}That is my duty as an angel.{wait}{clear}
There's no way you can stay?{wait}{clear}
I... already said I was sorry for being selfish, didn't I.{wait}{clear}
I shouldn't... make things any harder for you...{wait}{clear}
Hey, even after you go back to the Heavens, think of me once in a while, okay...?{wait}{clear}
No... I want to stay here on the surface.{wait}{clear}Even if it means breaking my duty...{wait}{clear}For you...{wait}{clear}
But a promise is... a promise, okay...?{wait}{clear}
Hey, wanna go shopping? Shopping! It'd be boring to come to such a pretty city and leave without doing anything, right?{wait}{clear}Going alone is boring too, so come with me.{wait}{clear}
